This place is equipped with quality features like maintenance staff and visitor parking. Additional things included here are separate entry for servant room, low density society, no open drainage around, waste disposal, corner property, pet friendly, wheelchair friendly and in a gated society. Power backup: Full. The flat is east facing. The flat has granite flooring.
